events.title: Devlog#3 : The Scenario Book
events.summary: Meet the Scenario BookThe best crash videos start with a great setup: a box wall in the right spot, a ramp at the right angle, cameras where the action happens. Building that by hand every time is slow. So we made the Scenario Book, a new app on your in-game tablet with 30 ready-made crash setups.The idea is simple: learn it once, deploy it instantly, experiment freely.Step 1: Learn it oncePick a scenario and press Start Learning.
